content: Indication-specific dosing for glucosamine sulfate, chondroitin sulfate, and methylsulfonylmethane (MSM) in combination includes the following regimens: Flex-a-Min, GNC Triflex: Administer 3 tablets per day orally. Osteo Bi-Flex plus MSM: Administer 4 capsules per day orally. Joint Movement Glucosamine with Chondroitin & MSM: Administer 30 mL per day orally. These combinations are intended for the relief of symptoms associated with osteoarthritis. However, the efficacy of these ingredients in combination has not been studied, and no conclusive results are available regarding their combined use. Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients (glucosamine sulfate, chondroitin sulfate, or MSM). Pregnancy and Lactation: Pregnancy Category: Unknown. Use is not recommended due to insufficient data. Lactation: Unknown. Use is not recommended due to a lack of safety information. Pregnancy Category A: This category is generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. However, this classification does not apply to the substances mentioned above, as their safety profiles during pregnancy and lactation remain undetermined.
